legal_ref: Pievienotās vērtības nodokļa likums, 41. pants (1)(1); rate 21% first set by 24.05.2012 likums "Grozījumi likumā 'Par pievienotās vērtības nodokli'" (LV 6.06.2012, Nr. 88), in force 1.07.2012; carried into the current PVN likums in force 1.01.2013
quote: 41.pants. ... (1) Ar nodokli apliekamiem darījumiem piemēro: 1) nodokļa standartlikmi 21 procenta apmērā (turpmāk — nodokļa standartlikme), ja šajā likumā nav noteikts citādi — Taxable transactions are subject to the standard rate of 21% unless otherwise provided. [2012 amendment: 'Aizstāt 5.panta pirmajā daļā ... “22 procentu” ar ... “21 procenta”. ... Likums stājas spēkā 2012.gada 1.jūlijā.']
source_title: Likumi.lv (official legal acts portal, Latvijas Vēstnesis): Pievienotās vērtības nodokļa likums, consolidated; start date from Latvijas Vēstnesis 6.06.2012 Nr. 88, https://www.vestnesis.lv/ta/id/248708

reduced_rates.scope: medicines and medical devices, specialised infant food, domestic scheduled passenger transport, accommodation services, firewood and heat supplied to households, fresh fruit/berries/vegetables (Annex 1); bread, milk, poultry meat and eggs (Annex 2) only 1 Jul 2026 – 30 Jun 2027 (PVN likums 42. pants)
books (print and electronic) and press/periodical publications in qualifying languages (42. pants (5), (7))
exports, intra-EU supplies, international transport and related services (43.–50. pants)

notes: Standard rate unchanged; the only enacted future change is the expiry on 30 June 2027 of the temporary 12% rate for bread, milk, poultry and eggs (transitional provision 48). Previous standard rate 22% (until 30 June 2012). TEDB (situation 2026-07-01) shows 21%, 12%, 5%, 0% — consistent; TEDB lists foodstuffs under 12%. Scheduled: from 2027-07-01: The 12% rate on bread, milk, poultry and eggs applies only from 1 July 2026 to 30 June 2027 (these revert to the 21% standard rate afterwards; standard rate itself unchanged).
